courses.summary: 以巴塔哥尼亞金礦為例，分析多來源礦石、地下物流與水資源效率。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A Patagonian gold case analyses multiple ore sources, underground logistics and water efficiency. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
